description: Water and shoreline with pile of dead branches in foreground, on the other side of the waterway is grasses , rock outcrop and a grove of pine trees along the shore.  This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Lyell Fork
